rows.name: File or link
rows.description: Upload any file (PDF, image, video, audio, doc) or paste a cloud link (Google Doc, Drive, Notion). Auto-detects type and renders the right preview.

rows.name: Drive (folder)
rows.description: A folder from your Files, pinned to this desk. Lists its contents, opens it in Files, and any file you drop or add saves straight into that folder.

rows.name: Field

rows.name: Page

rows.name: Table

rows.name: Chart
rows.description: PlexiDash — bar, line, area, pie or KPI charts from a table. Several on a desk make a dashboard.

rows.name: Document

rows.name: Spreadsheet

rows.name: Slides

rows.name: Flowchart
rows.description: Flowcharts, process maps, org charts and mind maps (PlexiDiagrams) — diagram by hand or generate with AI.

rows.name: Design

rows.name: Artwork

rows.name: SpeedDeck
rows.description: Elgato-style 10×3 macro pad — launch apps, run macros, control media, organise with folders. Toggle between this-task and Universal scopes.

rows.name: Task link
rows.description: Reference another task on this canvas — drag a task from the sidebar onto the canvas to create one

rows.name: Browser

rows.name: Mind map

rows.name: Diagram
rows.description: Flowcharts, hierarchies, server/software design, Venn — boxes, circles, text & image nodes joined with connectors

rows.name: Scratchpad
rows.description: Freeform sketch surface — draw, annotate and think visually with pressure-sensitive ink

rows.name: Shape
rows.description: A vector shape — rectangle, ellipse, diamond, triangle, hexagon, star, line or arrow — with fill, stroke and an optional label

rows.name: Card
rows.description: A titled callout card with an accent bar, bold title and body

rows.name: Custom block
rows.description: Design your own form/record — drop typed fields and place them where you want; save as a reusable template

rows.name: Desk agent
rows.description: A standing AI agent. Wire widgets INTO it as inputs, give it an instruction and a trigger, and it works on its own

rows.name: Send to a URL
rows.description: An outbound webhook. Wire a tool into it and its content is POSTed to your URL whenever it changes — send desk data out to Slack, Zapier or any HTTP endpoint

rows.name: Receive from a URL
rows.description: An inbound webhook. Gives you a unique URL — when an external system (Stripe, a form, curl) POSTs to it, the payload lands here and fires any wire drawn OUT of this tool

rows.name: Portal
rows.description: A live window into another task’s desk — watch it at a glance and click to dive in

rows.name: Living Doc
rows.description: A doc that writes itself — give it a brief and it keeps a living summary of this desk

rows.name: nodes
rows.description: A "desk" (marketing) / "project" (sidebar) is a top-level folder. The multiple_desks capability caps how many a tier may have.

rows.name: view
rows.description: Current pane view — replaces the assumption that the main area always shows a task canvas. As PlexiDesk grows into a workspace OS, the main pane routes between Home Dashboard, All Tasks, per-Project Dashboards, individual Tasks, and Connected Apps.

rows.name: widgets
rows.description: Re-export the Focus-Mode nav helpers so consumers (WidgetFocusMode, the split surfaces) can import them from the store alongside useWidgetStore.

rows.name: account
rows.description: Account store — single source of truth for "am I signed in, and as who?" on the renderer. Lifecycle: 1. App boots → init() loads the cached session from main (encrypted via safeStorage). If present, validates it against /accounts/me.

rows.name: documents
rows.description: Documents store — the standalone office files (doc / sheet / slides). Holds the list for the hub and the one open document for the editor. Body edits are debounced to disk so typing stays smooth and we never lose work.

rows.name: workItems
rows.description: The work_item store (Attention S3, §4). Work items NEVER pass through useNodeStore — listNodes excludes the kind, and every desk/room surface is blind to them by construction.

rows.name: capabilities
rows.description: Capability store — caches the per-tier resolved capability map for the signed-in user, refreshed on auth change + window focus + an imperative `refresh()` call. Consumers read via `useCapability(key)`.

rows.name: org
rows.description: The active organisation is the tenancy boundary for the whole workspace. The user's own local-first data lives in a reserved "Personal" org that is always available offline; the other options are the real server orgs the account has been invited to.

rows.name: messaging
rows.description: Apply a reaction add/remove to a message in the conversation map, immutably and idempotently (so the actor's own optimistic update plus the echoed broadcast do not double count). Returns a new messagesByConv.

rows.name: actionHistory
rows.description: One unified undo/redo timeline for structural workspace actions — creating, deleting, moving, renaming, resizing, recolouring, linking tasks, folders and widgets.

rows.name: focusSession
rows.description: Lightweight store for the *currently running* 5-min-Promise / focus session. History is read from the DB on demand (Garden, Trail later); this store holds only the active session + a per-tick countdown so the overlay can re-render.

rows.name: links
rows.description: Spatial-link store. Mirrors the widgets store's per-task lifecycle: loadForTask wipes + fetches; clear empties on task switch. Optimistic updates so the SVG overlay redraws immediately without waiting for IPC.

rows.name: timeBlocks
rows.description: Calendar time blocks for the currently-viewed range. The view sets the range (a week / a day); the store loads the blocks that overlap it and keeps an in-memory copy that create/update/remove patch optimistically-ish (we trust the main process result and…

rows.name: meetings
rows.description: PlexiMeet store. Thin wrapper over the main-process meetings store via IPC. Reads only real meetings; an empty history shows an honest empty state.

rows.name: presence
rows.description: Account-level presence (the "People Map"): who across your org/team is online right now and what they're doing. Rides the same authenticated messaging socket.

rows.name: files
rows.description: Object-URL cache so we can render the same file in multiple widgets without re-reading the bytes per render. Cleared on file delete.

rows.name: knowledge
rows.description: PlexiBrain knowledge base store. Thin wrapper over the main-process store via IPC; the renderer holds the current list and writes through. Reads only real entries, never seeds samples, so an empty brain shows an honest empty state.

rows.name: upgradePrompt
rows.description: Global "upgrade to unlock" prompt. Any gated action (a locked widget tile, hitting the desk limit, a Pro-only feature) calls promptUpgrade() with a short reason; the single <UpgradePromptModal/> mounted in App renders it.

rows.name: contextHealth
rows.description: Renderer-side Context Health (plexi-4.0). Reads the live context:* endpoints so desks can surface "what changed since you last looked" and "which related desks need attention".

rows.name: assistantChrome
rows.description: Chrome state for the global assistant: whether it is open, which of the three display modes it is in, and the sidebar-mode dock width.

rows.name: shares
rows.description: ShareService singleton — null in local-mock dev mode (no server), instantiated in prod / when explicitly configured. Created lazily so the renderer doesn't open a connection until the user actually uses the feature.

rows.name: webPanel
rows.description: The in-app browser panel's state (A2, AI-03, R4/R13): one right-panel browser serves citations, omnibar URLs, and web search results — the web never leaves Plexii; the system browser is an explicit escape, not the default.

rows.name: quickCreate
rows.description: Global quick-create: lets the command palette (Cmd+K) ask any module to create a new item, from anywhere in the app, without the user first navigating to that module and hunting for its "New" button.

rows.name: fileManager
rows.description: State for the file/folder manager view. The current folder (cwd, null = root) drives the listing; view mode and sort are persisted so the manager opens the way the user left it.

rows.name: call
rows.description: PlexiCam: peer-to-peer live audio/video calls. The signal server only relays the SDP offer/answer and ICE candidates between two accounts in the same presence audience; the media itself flows directly peer to peer (the server never sees it).

rows.name: forms
rows.description: PlexiForms store. A form is a thin record over a backing table: creating a form creates the table that holds its fields (columns) and responses (rows). Reads only real forms; an empty workspace has none.

rows.name: mail
rows.description: Mail store — the IMAP inbox the user connects with their own mailbox. All the IMAP work happens in the main process; this store holds the account status, the message list (envelope only), and the one open message body, and it drives both the dedicated Mail…

rows.name: mailTags
rows.description: The user's mail tags. Held apart from the mail store because a tag outlives any particular mailbox fetch: tags are the user's own structure and survive a refresh, a reconnect, or having no mail account at all.

rows.name: notice
rows.description: DEC-091 — the house NOTICE toast: one transient, non-blocking line for "a thing happened somewhere you are not looking", with an optional action that takes you there.

rows.name: onboarding
rows.description: Modular onboarding. There is one always-available "core" first-run flow plus any number of short, replayable feature tours.

rows.name: apps
rows.description: PlexiBuild store. Thin wrapper over the main-process apps store via IPC. Reads only real apps; an empty workspace shows an honest empty state.

rows.name: captureConsole
rows.description: The capture console's open/close state (Attention S5). Opened by the fb:command-new-work-item seam (palette, shortcuts, future surfaces) with optional prefill text; the console itself lives in App so it floats over every view.

rows.name: completionOffer
rows.description: DEC-052 (Track D) — the offer surface's state. The contract, from the ruling, made structural: - NEVER auto-complete: the only writer is the toast's confirm, and it runs the same accounted close path every surface uses.

rows.name: meetingRoom
rows.description: PlexiMeet live rooms: a multi-party meeting built as a WebRTC mesh. Each member holds one peer connection to every other member; the signal server only relays the roster and the SDP/ICE, never the media.

rows.name: signInPrompt

rows.name: guestCapture
rows.description: M6 (SPEC-003 P6, CR-12) — Guest Capture: record a meeting that happens OUTSIDE Plexii (Zoom, Meet, Teams — an external joinUrl booking, or any call playing through this machine).

rows.name: brand
rows.description: The organization Brand Kit, read by every surface that wants to present on brand (PlexiDesign today; Docs/Sheets/Slides/Projects as they adopt it).

rows.name: calendars

rows.name: dashboardLayouts

rows.name: deskView
rows.description: Per-desk view mode. A desk can be shown as the infinite spatial Canvas (the default) or as Columns (stacked scrollable walls).

rows.name: editorCommands
rows.description: A registry the active rich editor (Document, Slides) publishes its own commands into, so the global command palette (Cmd+K) can drive the editor without the palette needing to know anything about Tiptap or slide elements.

rows.name: knock

rows.name: overlay

rows.name: syncStatus

rows.name: widgetSetup
rows.description: Drives the per-widget AI setup preview. A menu action calls start(widgetId); the WidgetSetupPreview component (mounted once) runs the suggest IPC, shows the drafted items for approval, and applies the ticked ones in the widget's native format.

rows.name: aiAssistPreview
rows.description: AI Assist preview store. Every AI Assist action opens a single preview before anything is written.

rows.name: docCollab

rows.name: liveFolderEntries

rows.name: mailModal
rows.description: Which email is open, if any. A store rather than local state because the reader is opened from several places that do not know about each other -- the inbox widget on a desk, the mail view, a search hit -- and none of them should have to own the modal or…

rows.name: speeddeck
rows.description: Universal SpeedDeck store. Every SpeedDeck widget in "Universal" scope reads from THIS store and writes back to it; the store mirrors itself to disk via the speeddeck:* IPC.

rows.name: featureVotes
rows.description: Upvotes for coming-soon and planned PlexiSuite products. Each vote is a real account voting for a real feature key, so the team can both rank demand and notify the exact people who asked once a feature is ready to test.

rows.name: focusSplit

rows.name: openTray
rows.description: What you have open, kept per device. This is window state, not workspace data: which things YOU have on this machine right now, the same way a browser's tabs are not part of the pages.

rows.name: radar

rows.name: browserActions

rows.name: imap
rows.description: IMAP client — the thin layer that actually talks to the user's mail server. PlexiDesk connects directly from the desktop using imapflow, lists the most recent INBOX messages (envelope only, so the list loads fast), and fetches a full message body on demand…

rows.name: browserAgent
rows.description: The agentic-browsing loop (A6/B2, R26/R27/R28). One runtime, Plexii's:

rows.name: schema
rows.description: The complete SQLite schema, as one idempotent script of CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS statements.

rows.name: projectPlan

rows.name: agentDispatcher

rows.name: deskBundle
rows.description: One desk, packed into a file that can travel. workspaceExport.ts writes the WHOLE workspace and leaves file bytes on disk, which is right for "let me leave with everything" and wrong for "here is one desk, look at it in your browser".

rows.name: aiChat
rows.description: Local persistence for the AI-assistant chat: free-standing conversations and their messages, mirroring the documents.ts pattern (Row interfaces, rowTo mappers, prepared statements, org scoping).

rows.name: mentionResolver

rows.name: vault
rows.description: ── Crypto constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── PBKDF2-SHA256, 600k iterations = OWASP 2023 recommendation. Increase over time.

rows.name: customWidget
rows.description: Custom widget generation -- the user describes a tool in plain language and the model writes it. What comes back is a self-contained HTML fragment: markup, styles and logic in one piece, with no build step, no imports and no external assets.

rows.name: intentRules
rows.description: Deterministic intent rules (Attention S5; ARCHITECTURE §6 + R011). The capture classifier's FIRST pass: hard triggers that resolve without any model call — most captures ("remind me to…", "fyi:", "schedule a…") never pay model latency at all, which is what…

rows.name: agentHistory
rows.description: Agent invocation history + outcome bookkeeping. Three responsibilities: 1. Record every agent invocation as it happens, so the user can see what they ran, when, against which node, and what the agent replied — durable across reloads and across widgets. 2.

rows.name: streamingEnvelope
rows.description: Incremental scanner for the model's { "reply": …, "<items>": [ … ] } envelope. Both AI surfaces that stream ask Claude for the same shape — a reply string plus an array of objects — but they disagree on the array's key: the voice command uses "proposals",…

rows.name: externalCalendars
rows.description: Calendars that live somewhere else. External events are kept in their OWN table rather than folded into time_blocks, and that separation is the whole design.

rows.name: eventStore
rows.description: Append-only Event Store (spec §35, §49, ADR-0001). The system of record for Plexii 4.0. Events are immutable and append-only, enforced by SQLite triggers, not convention (PLX-EVT-010, PLX-EVT-030).

rows.name: relationshipStore
rows.description: Relationship store (spec §36, REQ-GPH) — provenance-carrying edges of the knowledge graph. Every edge is written with evidence (rejected at write time otherwise, PLX-GPH-001), a discovery method and a lifecycle state.

rows.name: flows
rows.description: PlexiFlow engine and store. A flow is a trigger plus an ordered list of actions the workspace already knows how to perform.

rows.name: search
rows.description: Global "find anything" search across the local workspace: node titles + descriptions, widget text, document bodies, table-row cells, file names, and PlexiBrain knowledge.

rows.name: nodeLifecycle
rows.description: Node lifecycle mechanics — the single owner of trash/restore/purge/detach semantics for the nodes table (Attention layer S1; ARCHITECTURE §2.5).

rows.name: creditMode
rows.description: Credit mode — routing AI calls through the PlexiDesk signal server on our Anthropic key, billed against the account's prepaid balance, with automatic fall-back to the user's own key (BYOK) when credits run out. This is the desktop half of the metered proxy.

rows.name: workspaceExport
rows.description: Portable workspace export/import. A .fbbackup (see backup.ts) is a SQLite copy: the right tool for "restore yesterday's workspace", and the wrong one for "let me leave". It needs this app's schema and this app's binary to read.

rows.name: documents
rows.description: Office documents store — CRUD for standalone doc / sheet / slides files. The body is persisted as a JSON string; the shape depends on doc_type and is validated only loosely here (the editors own the shape), so an older body schema never blocks a read.

rows.name: decisionStore
rows.description: Decision store (spec §37, REQ-DOM/REQ-APP) — persists Decisions with human-only ownership and approval (PLX-DOM-040), advisory-only AI commentary (PLX-DOM-041), the APP-020 approval gate, permanently-retained rejected alternatives (PLX-DOM-043), and an atomic…

rows.name: reports
rows.description: PlexiReports store. A report is a saved selection of tables plus a schedule and recipients. Generating one reads the real table data, builds an honest data summary, and (when an Anthropic key is set) asks the model to narrate it.

rows.name: browserAgentEnvelope
rows.description: The browser-agent round envelope (A6/B2): pure parsing + sanitising for what the model returns each round, kept free of Electron/SDK deps so it unit-tests directly (the agentEnvelope.ts precedent).

rows.name: widgetInputs
rows.description: What a custom widget can see, resolved from the wires drawn into it. The whole access model in one sentence: a generated widget reads exactly the widgets the user connected to it, and has no way to ask for anything else.

rows.name: orchestrator
rows.description: AI Orchestrator (spec §55, §67, §70, REQ-AI). The single internal abstraction through which all model invocation flows (AI-001): capability-aware routing that refuses under-capable models (AI-003), permission-scoped prompt assembly that cannot be overridden…

rows.name: sign
rows.description: ── fb_sign_requests (PlexiSign) ───────────────────────────────────────────── One row per signature request. signers and audit are JSON arrays — a request is a self-contained envelope, so there is no value in a separate table per signer for a local-first v1.

rows.name: backup
rows.description: Backup / export / restore for the single-file SQLite database. "Backup" here is a transactionally-consistent online snapshot via better-sqlite3's backup() — safe to take while the app is running and in WAL mode, and it consolidates into ONE self-contained…

rows.name: account
rows.description: Account session persistence — main-process only. We keep two facts on disk: 1. The session token issued by the signal server's /accounts/login (or /accounts/signup).

rows.name: agentBuilder

rows.name: mailTags
rows.description: Where a user's mail tags live. A tag is a saved criterion, not a drawer (see the note on MailTag in shared/types.ts).

rows.name: contacts

rows.name: markdownToTiptap
rows.description: Minimal markdown -> Tiptap doc JSON converter for living-page output. Why hand-rolled: tiptap-markdown lives in the renderer (it's a Tiptap extension that mounts onto an editor instance).

rows.name: eventSchemas
rows.description: Event JSON-Schema registry and validator (spec §64, PLX-EVT-043/044). Every Event type has a published, versioned schema at a stable dataschema URI, and events are validated against it.

rows.name: memory
rows.description: The self-building memory store (fb_memory). Durable facts / preferences / commitments about the user and their work, injected into the assistant's context so it stops starting cold.

rows.name: mailTriage
rows.description: Reading an inbox and proposing what to do with it. The model gets headers only — sender, subject, date, whether it was read, whether the sender published an unsubscribe.

rows.name: canvasSnapshots
rows.description: Desk time-travel snapshots. A snapshot is the full widget set for a task at a moment in time. We keep the last MAX_PER_TASK and prune older ones.

rows.name: knowledge
rows.description: ── fb_knowledge (PlexiBrain) ──────────────────────────────────────────────── CRUD plus a small relevance search used by both the PlexiBrain view and the AI grounding path. Mirrors the fb_tables store's shape exactly.

rows.name: chatJson
rows.description: Pure string helpers for reading the model's { "reply": ..., "actions": [...] } chat envelope.

rows.name: actionLabel

rows.name: telemetry
rows.description: Local usage telemetry. Reads aggregate counts from this machine's database (widgets by kind, tasks, folders, focus minutes) plus a cumulative AI-call counter, and shapes them into a snapshot the renderer reports to the signal server.

rows.name: customWidgets
rows.description: The user's personal library of AI-built widgets. A saved widget is a name, the plain-language spec that produced it, and a self-contained HTML document.

rows.name: mailAccount
rows.description: Mail account config — the IMAP connection details for the user's own mailbox. PlexiDesk talks to the mail server directly from the desktop, so the credentials live locally and never touch the signal server.

rows.name: agents
rows.description: Agent governance (spec §78, §79, REQ-AGT). Agents act on behalf of a human and never exceed them: effective permissions are a subset of the principal's (AGT-001), every agent has exactly one accountable human (AGT-005), delegation never escalates (AGT-014).

rows.name: chatUiBlocks
rows.description: Sanitiser for the envelope's optional "blocks" array (Plexii P4) — the interactive UI blocks the model emits inside an answer. Dependency-free (no Electron, no DB, no SDK) so it unit-tests in isolation, same policy as chatJson.ts and chatQuestion.ts.

rows.name: intentClassify
rows.description: The capture classifier (Attention S5) — hard rules first, Haiku fallback, to_remember floor.

rows.name: localAiSweeps
rows.description: Background local-AI passes: document enrichment and memory extraction. Both capabilities were already built, already consumed by retrieval, and free (they run on the local model).

rows.name: modelRouting
rows.description: Model IDs — kept in main process so renderer never sees raw IDs. These are THE place model versions are named.

rows.name: localModel

rows.name: dailyBriefContext
rows.description: Pure assembly of the real environment state into a compact context block for the Daily Brief. Kept side-effect free so it is unit-tested directly.

rows.name: filesFromUrl

rows.name: meetings

rows.name: embeddings
rows.description: ── fb_embeddings (semantic-retrieval foundation) ──────────────────────────── A vector store keyed by (item_type, item_id).

rows.description: Turn-level retrieval gating (A4, AI-10). Until A4, every substantive chat turn ran workspace retrieval and web search ceremonially — right for grounded question-answering, wrong for discovery ideation, where the user is answering Plexii's questions…

rows.name: extractCommitments
rows.description: M3 (SPEC-003 §3.6) — the commitment extractor, and the contract that keeps it honest (S3-DEC-021 applied to commitments): every commitment must point at the SEGMENT where it was made.

rows.name: upcasting
rows.description: Event schema upcasting (spec §64, PLX-EVT-035/044, DOM-012; ADR-0004). Events are immutable and read forever, so an Event written under an old schema is upcast to the current shape AT READ TIME.

rows.name: whisperCore
rows.description: The pure heart of local transcription — no electron, no process globals — so it runs identically in the main process AND in the utilityProcess worker, and unit-tests import it directly.

rows.name: forms
rows.description: ── fb_forms (PlexiForms) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── A form is metadata pointing at a backing fb_tables table (its fields = the table's columns, its responses = the table's rows).
